name: due soon
template: Hi {client}, a quick heads-up that invoice {invoice} for NGN {amount} is due on {due}. Thank you!

name: friendly
template: Hi {client}, just a reminder that invoice {invoice} (NGN {amount}) was due on {due}. If it's already sent, please ignore this. Thanks!

name: firm
template: Dear {client}, invoice {invoice} for NGN {amount} is now {days} days overdue. Please arrange payment this week or let us know when to expect it.

name: final
template: Dear {client}, this is a final reminder: invoice {invoice} (NGN {amount}) is {days} days overdue. Please settle within 5 working days to avoid service suspension.

name: escalate
template: Dear {client}, invoice {invoice} (NGN {amount}) is {days} days overdue and has been passed to our accounts manager, who will contact you.
